title.en: Supportive front desk with doctor criticism

text.en: Front desk coordinators and veterinary technicians receive frequent praise for their courteous, patient, and welcoming demeanor. In contrast, several reviewers voice frustration with attending veterinarians, describing rushed interactions and perceived lack of empathy.

title.en: Discontent regarding procedure and emergency fees

text.en: Despite the hospital's name, multiple pet owners report surprisingly high estimates for spaying, dental extractions, and emergency procedures. While a few surgical clients found pricing reasonable, most reviewers caution that medical bills rival expensive clinics.

Pet parents highlight positive clinical outcomes for senior dog tumor removals and pancreatitis treatment plans. However, other clients express disappointment over missed physical symptoms or feeling that medical options were limited during acute pet crises.

q.en: Is the clinic open for weekend visits?

a.en: Yes, reviewers report accessing care on Sunday mornings for urgent veterinary assessments and diagnostic evaluations.
Clients mention bringing pets in for routine physical wellness exams, core vaccinations, and nail trims.

q.en: Does the hospital perform surgical operations?

a.en: Yes, pet owners describe successful soft tissue surgeries, including mass removals and dental procedures.
